title: Trombonists Frank Jackay and Geechee Robinson
summary: Frank Jackay of Lake Charles was a section man; Geechee Robinson later played with Fletcher Henderson, jumped bands but stayed longest with Albert.

story.theme_name: Trombonists: who they heard, admired and learned from
story.community_name: Talking trombonists: who played the slide and how

blocks.x: Well, what about the trombone play?
Well, you had Frank Jackay. Strictly a section man. Yeah. Geechee Robinson. Where did Frank Jackay come from? Lake Charles, Louisiana. Cousin to Illinois.
Who did he play with, Frank?
Mostly with me. Mostly with you.
And Geechee Robinson, you once told me about, you were with Fletcher Henderson for a while.
After he left my band. Yeah.
Oh, so many bands. You can't have to have a typewriter or something, an ad machine for the bands Geechee played, but you couldn't stay.
He jumped from band to band?
Yeah, peculiar, what you're going to say, he's always getting arguments of, things with band. I believe he stayed with me longer than anyone he stayed with.
